title: An adaptive inverse-problem framework for one-loop five-gluon BCJ numerators
summary: An inverse problem comprises a matrix equation together with its unknown space, physical data, equivalence relation, and validation tests. We formulate Bern--Carrasco--Johansson (BCJ) numerator construction as an exact adaptive inverse problem. A fixed scientific specification determines the theory, graph conventions, coefficient field, locality and power counting, cut data, observable equivalence, and independent checks.
